reviews.title: Service Model
reviews.author: Adrian Tchaikovsky
reviews.summary: To fix the world they must first break it, further. Humanity is a dying breed, utterly reliant on artificial labor and service. When a domesticated robot gets a nasty little idea downloaded into its core programming, they murder their owner. The robot discovers they can also do something else they never did before: They can run away.

reviews.title: Mother of Learning
reviews.author: nobody103
reviews.summary: Zorian Kazinski, a mage student of no particular renown, is slain during an invasion of his city and inexplicably awakens a month back in time. Trapped in a mysterious time loop, he must face enemies far beyond him with his only advantage being the ability to try and try again.
